E-03 panda safety firmware: CSR-C-01 (implemented), CSR-C-02 (partly), CSR-C-03 (not yet), CSR-C-04 (not yet), CSR-C-05 (not yet), CSR-C-06 (not yet), CSR-C-09 (not yet). E-01/E-02 SoC software and models: CSR-C-05 (not yet), CSR-C-06 (not yet), CSR-C-07 (partly), CSR-C-08 (not yet), CSR-C-10 (not yet), CSR-C-11 (partly), CSR-C-12 (not yet), CSR-C-13 (not yet), CSR-C-14 (not yet), CSR-C-15 (not yet). comma.ai back end: CSR-C-11 (partly), CSR-C-12 (not yet), CSR-C-14 (not yet). Owner, installer and operation: CSR-C-04 (not yet), CSR-C-13 (not yet), CSR-C-15 (not yet), CSR-C-16 (not yet).
svg.text: Figure 6-1 · The cybersecurity concept on the item
The concept-level requirements of §7 on the places §6 allocates them to, with the goal each serves, its CAL and its status at the baseline
the envelope: safety mode, boot chain, CAN checks
The panda firmware shall enforce the Toyota
safety mode and reject any mode/parameter…
Release panda firmware shall not accept a
debug signing key and shall not enable…
The safety MCU shall boot only firmware
whose integrity and authenticity are verified…
be configured so the running safety firmware…
the SoC shall not flash unauthenticated…
openpilot, params and IPC, updater, SSH, remote access
the SoC shall not flash unauthenticated…
maneuver, joystick) shall be absent or…
ML model artefacts shall be loaded without
executing code from the artefact, and only…
SSH shall be disabled by default and shall
not ship with an embedded authorized key; if…
Remote RPCs in the reference configuration
shall not permit arbitrary-URL upload, SSH…
Software updates shall be installed only after
data and the device identity key shall be…
Decommissioning shall wipe personal data and
update signing, transport; outside the item (CA-01)
Software updates shall be installed only
location data and the device identity key…
shall be configured so the running safety…
and revoke/retire the device identity key
Implemented means in the reference build and not verified; no requirement is verified yet. CAL values are proposals for the assessor (§3). Each requirement is refined in WP-S-07.

g.text: Terms: CA-nn cybersecurity assumption on an entity outside the item (WP-C-10 §2) · CAL cybersecurity assurance level, 1 to 4 (ISO/SAE 21434) · CAN controller area network: the vehicle's data bus · CSG-nn

cybersecurity goal (WP-C-10) · CSR-nn cybersecurity requirement: CSR-C-nn at concept level (WP-C-10 §7), CSR-nnn refined (WP-S-07) · E-nn element of the item (WP-C-01 §3.1), E-01…E-06 · IPC inter-process

communication · LD-SDA LionDriver Supervised Driving Assistance, the item · MCU microcontroller: the panda safety processor (STM32H7) · ML machine learning · RDP read-out protection of the MCU's flash (option bytes)

· RPC remote procedure call · SoC system on chip: the comma device's main processor, running openpilot (QM) · SSH secure shell (remote login) · WP-nn work product, e.g. WP-C-04; the letter is its area (M management,
C concept, S system, H hardware, W software, V validation, P processes, A analyses, O operation, K safety case) · WRP write protection of the MCU's flash (option bytes)
